description: Pydantic framework pack: validators and model fields are invoked by Pydantic at validation time, never by in-repo callers.
notes: A method decorated with @model_validator(mode="after") or @field_validator is called by Pydantic when the model validates. Model fields (class attributes of a BaseModel subclass or a @dataclass) are populated from external data — see the frameworkField flag in src/parse-py.js.
